hypothesis.statement: The whole residual is now ONE consistent two-register transposition, and it is downstream of a single decision: which FPR receives the SECOND of the two `lfs` loads. Target loads the damage field first into f1 (`@0x114 lfs f1,452(r3)`) and the base field second into f0 (`@0x118 lfs f0,444(r3)`), then divides `@0x134 fdivs f0,f0,f1`; ours loads damage into f0 (`@0x114 lfs f0,452(r3)`) and base into f1 (`@0x118 lfs f1,444(r3)`) and divides `@0x134 fdivs f1,f1,f0`. Everything after that follows mechanically, because MWCC writes the quotient into whichever register already holds the dividend: the guard compare at 0x11c, where the target tests the damage load in f1 and ours tests it in f0 against the same hoisted `one` constant, the clamp compare (`@0x138 fcmpo cr0,f0,f31` against ours `fcmpo cr0,f1,f31`), the low-clamp assignment (`@0x140 fmr f1,f31` against ours `fmr f0,f31`), the high-clamp constant load (`@0x148 lfs f1,@lbl_80343BEC` against ours `lfs f0,...`), the second compare (`@0x14c fcmpo cr0,f0,f1` against ours `fcmpo cr0,f1,f0`), the pass-through copy (`@0x158 fmr f1,f0` against ours `fmr f0,f1`) and the narrowing store (`@0x15c frsp f0,f1` against ours `frsp f0,f0`) are all the same swap. Four levers have now been measured against that one decision - declaration order of the two f32 loads (twice, at two different alignments), declaration width of the quotient/carrier pair, declaration order of the quotient/carrier pair, and statement order of the two loads - and every one is NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL, so the assignment is made after the front end and no spelling of those constructs reaches it. The next lane's step 1 is therefore NOT another reorder: it is to change what the second load READS - e.g. reading the base field through a different expression form (a cached row pointer, an offsetof view, or the array subscript written as pointer arithmetic) so the two loads no longer originate in one addressing web - and if that is also NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL, this function is source-exhausted at 10 differing words, MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE 0, CLASS RECOLOR, and should go to a webfrank lane as a provenanced customer.
